definitions.explanation: The part of the leg between the hip and the knee.

examples.japanese: スクワットで{太腿|ふともも}の{筋肉|きんにく}を{鍛|きた}える。
examples.english: I strengthen my thigh muscles with squats.

examples.japanese: {太腿|ふともも}が{筋肉痛|きんにくつう}で{歩|ある}きにくい。
examples.english: My thighs are sore and it's hard to walk.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{私|わたし}の{太腿|ふともも}の{上|うえ}で{寝|ね}ている。
examples.english: The cat is sleeping on my thigh.

examples.japanese: マラソンの{後|あと}、{太腿|ふともも}がガクガクして{階段|かいだん}を{降|お}りるのが{大変|たいへん}だった。
examples.english: After the marathon, my thighs were shaking and it was hard to go down stairs.

examples.japanese: {太腿|ふともも}の{内側|うちがわ}の{筋肉|きんにく}は{普段|ふだん}あまり{使|つか}わないので、{意識|いしき}してトレーニングした{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: The muscles on the inner thigh aren't used much in daily life, so it's better to train them consciously.

notes:
{太腿|ふともも} refers to the thigh. {太|ふと} means 'thick' and {腿|もも} means 'thigh/leg.'

ANATOMY:
- {太腿|ふともも}の{前|まえ}: front of thigh (quadriceps area)
- {太腿|ふともも}の{裏|うら}: back of thigh (hamstring area)
- {内|うち}{太腿|もも}: inner thigh

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {太腿|ふともも}が{太|ふと}い: to have thick thighs
- {太腿|ふともも}を{細|ほそ}くする: to slim the thighs
- {太腿|ふともも}の{筋肉|きんにく}: thigh muscles

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {膝|ひざ}: knee
- {脹脛|ふくらはぎ}: calf
- {足|あし}: leg/foot
- {腰|こし}: waist/lower back
- {尻|しり}: buttocks
